args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export missing the first week's email
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Address the issue where weekly scheduled exports do not send the report on the day the schedule is created if created early in the day. Investigate and adjust the calculation of the first run date (`firstRunAt` function) to make sure it correctly schedules the export for the current week if the creation time is before the scheduled export time.
